name: ahlimana
description: Select a defense type card on your board and increase it´s value by 2. Until the end of this turn´s damage calculation gain 2 extra health points. (you can not gain there health points if your health is already at 10)

name: Akane
description:
Akane became a vibrant conduit of the lands.
Hailing from the planes of Jade she has inner turmoil.
Will she be able to defeat her own jealous nature or be consumed by it?

name: Alyna
description: To play this card you must discard 2 cards from your hand.

name: Amaya invocation
description: (Sentinel) If you have “Amaya the Eternal Sunlight” on your board, increase the value of all cards on your board by 2.

name: Amaya light fusion
description: Search your deck for a card or discard pile for a card that contains "Amaya" in it´s name. This card´s effect can be activated only once per game.

name: Amaya
description:
Born from a cataclysm of flame and fury, she emerged as more than a mortal echo of the stars, forged to stand eternal.
Her presence kindles hope, a beacon for all those lost in the endless.

name: amber of fortitude
description: Select a card on your board. It can not be removed until the end of next turn’s damage calculation.

name: Ana
description: Your opponent can not play a mage card for the rest of this turn.

name: Anthamos
description: Choose a random card from your opponent’s hand, they must discard that card. If you have a mage card in your hand, choose an additional card for them to discard.

name: arcane shield
description: Gain 2 shield. If a Mage card is in your hand gain an additional 1 shield. (Shield is treated as health points, but at the end of this turn’s damage calculation you lose all shield you gained, from all sources).

name: Ares vigil
description: (Sentinel) If you have “Ares the Infinite’s Spear” on your board, remove up to 2 cards from your opponent’s board.

name: Ares
description:
Anata’s shining beacon of hope.
A leader of the fiercest warriors dedicated to protecting the vault of the old world.

name: Astral evolution
description: Play this card only if you control at least 2 other cards on your board. Select 1 card on your board. Search the top 5 cards of your deck for a card with a higher value or a different type than the selected card. Play it, replacing the original card.

name: Asya
description: While this card is on the board, every time you replace a card on your board increase this card’s value by 2.

name: at the end
description: Immediatelly after you play this card calculate the damage you would take for the turn. if you are about to lose during this turn´s damage calculation the game continues and you are left on 1 health point.

name: Atlas
description:
An old friend of Endal, a mentor.
And a traitor — at least in the eyes of others.
He was there when Ichiko lost her eyes and when Lambert took what was never his.
The true protector of Vahlen.

name: axe to meet you
description: (Sentinel) If you have "Diarmuid the Rage" on your board, you may decrease your life points until you are left with at least 1. Increase "Diarmuid the Rage"’s value by the amount of health points you lost.

name: boo bees
description: Swap the values of any two cards on your board. If a Mage card is in your hand you may swap the values with your opponent’s card values.

name: Chad
description: Pick a card on your board and increase its value by 3.

name: Convincer cannon
description: While it is on the board, this card changes its type at the end of every damage calculation alternating between the attack and defense types. While this card is in the defense type it has a value of 1. While it is in the attack type it has a value of 6.

name: Courage and Honour
description: During this turn´s damage calculation reduce all opponent attack type card values by 2.

name: craftsmanship
description:
A farmer, long before he was a warrior.
His horns were used to protect those unable to defend themselves.
Now he lives a peaceful life, until destiny calls once more.

name: Debil
description:
A creature so small it could fit in your hand, yet Sylvie guards it like a crown jewel.
No one knows if it’s a weapon, a familiar, or just… weird.

name: Diarmuid
description:
"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARGH!!!"
rage continues

name: Dor
description:
A farmer, long before he was a warrior.
His horns were used to protect those unable to defend themselves.
Now he lives a peaceful life, until destiny calls once more.

name: eclipse of gold
description: When you play this card, reveal the top card of your deck. If it is a Mage card activate its effect immediately.

name: elemental surge
description: Increase the value of a card on your board by 1. If a Mage card is in your hand increase another card’s value by 1.

name: Endal Might
description: (Sentinel) If you have "Paladin Endal" on your board, increase it’s value by 2. It now counts as both an Attack and a Defense card.

name: Endal
description: Endal is the shining warrior of Vahlen’s forces. The leader the people need and believe in. His mighty sword holds thousands of lives and his heart knows no bounds in love for his lands.

name: Enemy
description: If you have less than 4 health points, remove all cards from both boards.

name: Energy Unleash
description: If you have 7 Mage cards in your discard pile, select a card on your board and increase its value by 10. If you have 'Melody the Energy Scribe' on your board, return a Mage card from your discard pile to your hand. (Excluding this card).

name: Enid
description:
The bear mother; She has the spirits of her ancestors locked away so they may not witness the atrocities their people are capable of.
If provoked she turns into a bear as tall and wide as the mountains she calls home.

name: Enterrna
description: An ancient demon who cursed princess Ahlimana, and now roams the land in search of victims too weak to deny her charms.

name: Evade
description: Gain 1 shield, your opponent’s next card with a value has a value of 0. (Shield is treated as health points, but at the end of this turn’s damage calculation you lose all shield you gained from all sources).

name: Fair winds
description: Both players draw 2 cards from their deck.

name: Fate Whisper
description: (Board) Add +1 to all dice roll results for your card effects. If you fail a coin flip, you may flip again once.

name: Feather of the fauhaux
description: Remove a card from your board and restore health points equal to half it´s value, rounded down.

name: Flowers of the sea
description: (Sentinel) If you have "Neume the Flower of the New Sea" on your board, track the next 5 cards your opponent draws. For each of those draws, roll a D3. On a roll of 3, your opponent takes 1 damage.

name: fluffy concoction
description: (Board) This card starts with 3 “Fluff” tokens on it. During damage calculation, you may remove any number of “Fluff” tokens from it to gain that much shield. (Shield is treated as health points, but at the end of this turn’s damage calculation you lose all shield you gained, from all sources).

name: From time
description: Return all cards played this turn, excluding this card, to their respective hands and restore 2 health points.

name: fush ion
description: (Board) Every time you play a mage card, until the end of the current turn’s damage calculation all cards on your board have their values increased by 1.

name: Gobo no
description: If you haven´t played a mage card during this turn, when your opponent plays a card from their hand you may play this card and negate the activation of your opponent´s card, then discard both cards.

name: Golden Sun
description: (Board) At the end of every damage calculation, you restore 1 health point.

name: Gyhran
description: A specter, death itself. Once a long time ago, Gyhran was a captain of the rifle gauntlets until he understood the soul smiths do not know with what they are interfering.

name: Happy Lonchich
description: discard a card from your hand. Then return 1 card from either your discard pile or your board to your hand.

name: heart and soul
description: if all cards with a value on your board are of the attack type, reduce all damage you would take during this turn´s damage calculation to zero.

name: Hjolthar
description: During this turn’s damage calculation all damage you would take is halved.

name: horacio the bard
description: (BOARD) If this card’s adjacent board spaces are filled with cards with a value increase both their values by 2.

name: Hu´Arya
description: Faster than thought, wilder than the wind - Hu´arya dances through battle with a laugh on her lips and both guns blazing. Where she leaps, chaos follows, and only the quickest survive her storm of bullets.

name: Ichiko
description:
Her scimitar holds the soul of her long gone husband.
He aids Ichiko on her quest for vengeance with his eyes, and she holds the love of her life on the edge of her blade.

name: Inhib
description: During damage calculation, if this card is on your board decrease all card values on your board by 1 and gain 3 shield. (Shield is treated like HP, but at the end of this turn’s damage calculation you lose all shield you gained, from all sources).

name: inikliona winter cold
description: (Sentinel) If you have "Inikliona the Ice" on your board, select a space on your opponent’s board. It becomes frozen and while "Inikliona the Ice" is on your board no cards can be played to it. Remove any card that was in it before playing this card.

name: Inikliona
description: Inikliona is the frozen queen of the north. The mother of Amaya, Inikliona’s sister, cursed her to live without the warmth of fire. She learned to accept the warmth of the eternal cold.

name: Insita
description: Select a card on your opponent’s board with a modified value and remove it.

name: Isaac
description:
Isa’ac does not bow, he does not falter.
He is the Hundred’s bulwark, the kingdom’s judgment.

name: Isylda
description:
“The shaper of rocks and earth, the tamer of sand dunes and the wind.
Isylda is a conduit of power for the lands themselves.”

name: Jade Sentinel
description: To play this card you must discard 3 cards from your hand.

name: Joe the menace
description: When this card is replaced or removed from the board you take 2 damage and draw a card.

name: Juy
description: Search your deck for a card of the same type as this card, but a different value and add it to your hand.

name: Kaito
description: When this card is played, increase its value by 1 for each card you have in your hand.

name: Kieran
description: At the beginning of a turn, while this card is on the board, you may flip a coin. If heads deal 1 damage to your opponent.

name: Kuju
description: This card’s value is determined by the roll of a six sided die.

name: Kyria
description: During damage calculation, if you deal damage to your opponent, and this card is on the board, heal for 2.

name: Lambert the arcanium Master
description: You may play this card only if you have less than 5 health points. when this card is played remove all other attack type cards from your board. This card´s value becomes equal to the result of adding up all the values of the removed cards.

name: Lambert
description:
Lambert was a marvelous scientist before Arcana Zero.
Now he is a vengeful spirit with a fiery thirst for vengeance.

name: loss of sense
description: Remove a mage card that is on your opponent’s board.

name: Marcy
description: Nobody knows her true name, at the end of the day not many even get to the "Marcy" before laying slain at her musket’s call.

name: Melody
description: When this card is played, its value becomes equal to the number of Mage cards in your discard pile.

name: Meyra
description: Before this turn’s damage calculation, after your opponent has finished playing their cards, you may play 1 Mage card from your hand. (Even if you have already played a Mage card this turn)

name: Mirage
description: If this card is discarded from your hand or deck due to an opponent’s card effect they take 3 damage.

name: Miyu
description: Discard 1 card to play this card. You may play this card onto your opponent’s board as if it were your own.

name: Muhreem
description: Shuffle a card from your opponent’s board to their deck.

name: mystic
description: Select a mage card in your opponent’s discard pile. This card’s effect becomes the same as the effect of the chosen mage card.

name: Nattalie the reader
description: draw 2 cards from the top of your deck.

name: Necromancer
description: Every time you discard a card from your hand or deck this card gains 1 stack of 'Malevolence'. During every damage calculation add up the number of 'Malevolence' stacks on this card to your attack score.

name: Neume
description: Discard 1 card from your hand to deal 2 damage to your opponent.

name: Neyla Programming
description: (Sentinel) If you have "Neyla the Machina" on your board, then after each damage calculation, look at the top 3 cards of your deck and return them in any order. This effect only applies while "Neyla the Machina" is on your board.

name: Neyla
description: Neyla was a prodigal child in the old world. Now an experienced engineer she developed her own way of fighting the forces of vengeance.

name: Nikolina
description: While this card is on the board during damage calculation, if your defense is higher than your opponent’s attack, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the difference.

name: Oppsie
description: (BOARD) Every time you play a card, flip a coin. if you get heads reduce the value of a card on your oppnent´s board by 2; if you get tails you lose 1 health point. if you have "joe the menace" on your board treat every coin flip as a "heads".

name: Overhack
description: when you play this card declare a card type (mage, value, sentinel); then draw a card. if the card you draw is the declared type inrease all card values on your board by 2.

name: Overtake
description: When you play this card prevent both players from playing any more cards and go to this turn’s damage calculation.

name: Owl
description: Both players shuffle their hands into their decks. Then your opponent draws 4 cards and you draw 5.

name: perfect calm
description: gain 5 shield. (shield is treated as health points, but at the end of this turn´s damage calculation you lose all shield you gained from all sources)

name: perfect parry
description: If your opponent played a card with the same value as your last played card (Defense or Attack), double the value of your next played card.

name: powderpelt penny
description: For every card played by either player decrease this card’s value by 1.

name: Profit
description: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Discard one of them, put one of them into your hand and return the rest to the bottom of your deck.

name: Prophet
description: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent’s deck. Discard any mage cards you find to your opponent’s discard pile.

name: Rej Aura
description: Restore 2 Health Points. If a Mage card is in your hand, restore an additional 1 Health Point.

name: Rina
description:
Rina was a young orphan when Atlas found her.
Under his training she learned the quick ways of the bow.
Now she fires enchanted flying arrows that pierce and always catch their prey.

name: round all day every day
description: (Sentinel) If you have "Vismal the Aggression" on your board, reduce the value of all cards on your opponent’s board by 2. Any card whose value drops below 1 is removed.

name: sacred ashes
description: This card starts with 5 “Awakening” counters on it. During every damage calculation while this card is on the board remove one “Awakening” counter from it. When the final “Awakening” counter is removed from this card search your deck, discard pile, or hand for “Enflamed Serpent of the Sacred Ashes” and play it to your board replacing this card with it.

name: sacred springs
description: This card starts on the board with 0 stacks of 'Sacred Salvation'. Every time you gain shield while this card is on the board add a stack of 'Sacred Salvation' to it. If this card has 8 stacks of 'Sacred Salvation' you win the game.

name: Salan
description:
The next Mage card you play from your hand activates its effect twice.
(This card’s effect transfers onto the next turn for activation and this card cannot affect Mage cards that stay on the board.)

name: Samuel
description: (BOARD) At the end of every damage calculation, you may draw a card.

name: serpent of the sacred ashes
description: This card can only be played to your board with the card effect of “The Enflamed Sacred Ashes”. This card can not be removed from your board.

name: Shadow
description:
Vahlen’s most decorated assassin.
His mission is simple: remove all and anyone who dares smith the souls of those gone on the fields of battle.

name: shake my hand
description: when you play this card lose 2 health points and discard 1 card from the top of your deck. if you do, search your deck for any effect card with a value, reveal it and add it to your hand.

name: shild of atlas
description: (Sentinel) If you have "Paladin Atlas" on your board, your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 2 cards that they must show to you. If either drawn card is a mage card, heal yourself for 2.

name: Signardir
description: When your entire village is made up of engineers and inventors with no trace of magic, owning a floating shield that obeys your every command is a surefire way to get yourself exiled.

name: Snugam
description: This card’s value is determined by the roll of a six sided die.

name: SoulSteal
description: Deal 1 damage to your opponent and restore 1 Health Point.

name: spirits awaken
description: during this turn you may play 2 cards with a value.

name: Steve
description: Every time you play a mage card, increase this card’s value by 1.

name: Sylvia
description: When this card is played, restore 3 health points.

name: Synruna
description: While this card is on the board, if your opponent would restore health points, they restore half that amount instead (rounded up).

name: system override
description: look at the top 3 cards of your deck. return them to the top of the deck in any order.

name: teachings of the master
description: (BOARD) Treat this card, while it is on the board, as a defense value 2 card with no effect. If you have no other cards with an effect on your board when this card is played both players discard their hand and draw 3 cards.

name: Teleport
description: Return target opponent’s card to their deck.

name: Teron
description: (BOARD) At the end of every damage calculation roll a D6. On a roll of 4 or higher discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.

name: Time Bend
description: Return a card from your discard pile to your hand. If a Mage card is in your hand, additionally add a card from either discard pile to your hand.

name: Ukuhul Arise
description: (Sentinel) If you have "Uk’Uhul" on your board, search your discard pile for up to 4 cards and add them to your hand.

name: Ukuhul
description: Uk’Uhul is the central construct of darkness. A massive hulking giant made up of thousands of souls that scream to be released from the chains of this world.

name: Umbria
description: What do you get when you combine a genius misled inventor with a rogue AI that has direct access to her prefrontal cortex? Trouble.

name: UnUngrun
description:
Flip a coin. If you get heads, search your deck for a card and add it to your hand.
If you get tails, you take 1 damage.

name: unending anguish
description: Discard 4 cards from the top of your deck. if you discard any mage cards in this way you restore 1 health point and your opponent takes 1 damage.

name: unstable dilation
description: Flip a coin. If you get heads, search your deck for a card and add it to your hand. If you get tails, you take 1 damage.

name: Valerimona
description: Valerimona is the soul of the ancient magic that resides in all things, before arcana zero, before the nexus became the reason of existance, she was there. And she knows...

name: Valeris Ignis
description: (Sentinel) if you have "Valerimona the scroll of ancients" on your board, the next card you play that has an effect, either mage card or a card with a value, activates it´s effect twice.

name: Venom of terrna
description: (Sentinel) While "En’Terrna" is on your board, your opponent gains 1 poison counter each time they heal. During damage calculation, they take 1 damage per poison counter.

name: Vismal
description: Vismal is Salan’s best friend and partner in crime. He loves to cause havoc more than he loves to eat. A legend says he once ate an entire goat in one sitting. He is a mouse.

name: Wish
description:
Roll a D6. On a roll of 2 draw a card, on a roll of 4 restore 4 Health Points.
On a roll of 6 select a card on your board and double its value. On a roll of 1, 3, and 5 nothing happens.

name: Yasmin
description:
If your opponent has more Mage cards in their discard pile than you, they must roll a D6 for each excess Mage card.
On a roll of 4 or higher, they take 1 damage for each successful roll.

name: Zahra
description: For every empty space on both player’s boards increase this card’s value by 1.
